review_text: I absolutely love this shop! The customer service was incredibly attentive, and my order arrived two days ahead of schedule. The packaging was pristine. 10/10 will buy again!
The item I received looks completely different from the pictures online. The stitching is coming undone, and it feels incredibly cheap. I want a refund or a replacement immediately.

Worst experience ever. The delivery driver threw the package at my door and broke the glass item inside. If your management team doesn't contact me to resolve this right now, I am filing a formal lawsuit against your company.
